Description

A Gentler Way to Pump

True-to-baby suction rhythm, skin-friendly silicone and 30-minute auto stop to help make daily pumping feel natural, gentle and comfortable.

Better Fit. Better Comfort.

The exclusive patented DoubleFit™ flange is made to fit securely and comfortably, and reduce slipping or tugging while boosting pumping efficiency by 28.2%.*
*based on internal user feedback

Ultra-Light, Hands-Free Technology

Weighing only 8 oz, M5 Smart fits comfortably in your bra for cord-free, hands-free pumping – so you can move, work or care for your baby while you pump.

Pumping That Adapts to You

With three pumping modes and nine suction levels, M5 Smart lets you adjust each session to suit your own body’s needs – for comfortable and efficient milk expression at anytime.

Only 4 Parts to Clean

Made with BPA-free, food-grade silicone and PP, M5 Smart keeps after care simple with only four washable parts, which can be sterilised in 3 minutes and are heat safe up to 212°F.

Easy Control from Your Phone

Enjoy the complete Momcozy experience with the app. Adjust modes and suction levels, track milk output, and view visual pumping stats by day, week, or month – hands free – leaving the pump in place.

Specifications

Suction Power: 285 mmHg
Pumping Modes: 3 (Stimulation, Expression, Mixed)
Suction Levels: 9
Milk Collector Capacity: 160 ml / 5.4 oz
Noise Level: <48 dB
Battery Life: 180 min (≈ 6 pumping sessions)
Charging Time: 120 min
Weight: 230 g

Note:
Breast size can change before and after pumping. Measure just before pumping for accuracy.

Safety Warning:
Do NOT use this device if you have a cardiac pacemaker, implanted defibrillator, or any other metallic or electronic implant, as it may cause electromagnetic interference or serious injury.

Compatibility Note:
All accessories are fully compatible with both M5 and M5 Smart.

FAQs

How do I connect M5 Smart to the app?

Turn on your
M5 Smart.

Open the
Momcozy App
and make sure Bluetooth is enabled.
Tap Add Device, select M5 Smart, or scan the QR code on the pump.
Once connected, you’ll see the control page.

Click ：

User manuals

Can I control both pumps at the same time?

Yes. The app supports
dual control
, so you can adjust both pumps together with one tap.
You can also switch between left / right pump control and set different modes or suction levels for each side.

Can I connect M5 Smart to multiple phones?

For the best experience, connect to one phone at a time.
If you want to switch phones, disconnect from the current device first and pair again on the new phone.

Can I use M5 Smart without the app?

Yes. The Momcozy App is optional—M5 Smart can also be used directly with the pump controls.

What can I control in the app?

Once connected, you can start/stop pumping, switch modes, adjust suction levels, and check key pump status (such as battery level) right from the
Momcozy App
.

What kind of pumping stats can I view in the app?

The app can show a clear overview of your pumping records, including:

Daily / weekly / monthly summaries
Total logged output (based on manual entries)
Session frequency and duration

What's the difference between M5 Smart and M5?

M5 Smart is an
upgraded version
of M5 with
app control and longer battery life.

You can adjust modes and suction levels right from your phone—no need to reach into your bra or fumble with buttons during a session. The app also helps you log milk output and pumping sessions, so you can stay organized and track your routine more easily.

M5 Smart also lasts longer (up to 180 mins vs. 150 mins), while keeping the same compact, fully in-bra design.

Why is pumping with M5 Smart more comfortable than other pumps?

M5 Smart is made to feel gentler and easier to wear.
The DoubleFit™ flange
and baby mouth-like suction rhythm help create a softer, more natural-feeling pumping experience. With
30-minute auto stop
and an
8 oz
ultra-light design, it’s more comfortable for everyday pumping—at home, at work, or on the go.
